missing_values: Empty CSV cells are missing/suppressed, not zero. Percentages are 0-100; ratios are fractions. No statistical independence is implied by rows.

fields.geography: Panel, England and Wales, or one of seven custom regional groups; panel and national rows overlap their regional rows. Do not sum both.
fields.current_all_share_pct: Regional Q3 2026 all mentions / panel Q3 2026 all mentions * 100.
fields.current_filtered_share_pct: Regional Q3 2026 filtered mentions / panel Q3 2026 filtered mentions * 100.

fields.geography: Panel, England and Wales, or one of seven custom regional groups; panel and national rows overlap their regional rows. Do not sum both.
fields.quarter: Calendar transaction or decision quarter YYYY-Qn; charge quarter follows source methodology. Periods have different data vintages.
fields.authorities: Number of included planning authorities in this regional group. The Panel contains 253, including only seven in Wales.
fields.all_approval_unit_mentions: Source sum of units across approved application records. May include repeated stages, inferred quantities and non-dwelling units; missing quantities contribute zero. Not unique homes.
fields.excluding_reserved_matters_unit_mentions: Source unit sum after excluding case-insensitive proposal text match reserved matters. Not a deduplicated scheme pipeline.
fields.removed_unit_mentions: All approval unit mentions minus filtered mentions, count.

common.baseline: 2025-Q3 for annual, 2026-Q2 for quarterly; current is provisional2026-Q3
common.definition: All mentions or excluding reserved-matters text matches
common.authorities: Included authorities; stable source count is not proof of complete capture

leave_one_region_out.csv.difference_from_full_pp: Remaining percentage change minus whole-panel percentage change; percentage points
leave_one_region_out.csv.direction_reversed: True only if remaining and full absolute changes have opposite signs; zero is not reversal

regional_contributions.csv.contribution_pp: 100*(regional current-regional prior)/full-panel prior; additive percentage-point contribution to full-panel change
regional_contributions.csv.change_pct: Regional own percentage change, not contribution

panel_comparisons.csv.groups_falling: Unweighted number of custom regional groups with negative change; not a population statistic
